name: BillboardApp
description: Billboard to display text slides, images, and banner on monitor or TV.
fullDescription: Billboard App is a comprehensive Windows desktop application that transforms a PC monitor (or multiple monitors) into a rotating content display with multi-monitor support, content scheduling, music/audio, and a full admin panel.
features: Multi-monitor support with Mirror, Sequential, and Conveyor display modes
Image and video content rotation with configurable intervals
Animated text slides with full styling options
Scrolling banner ticker with directional control
Background music loop with per-slide audio support
Audio device selector for flexible output routing
System tray integration for quick access to admin panel
